simple.prompt: Concession with noun phrase: '___ the torrential downpour, the open-air festival continued.'
simple.explanation: 'Despite' dan 'In spite of' diikuti oleh Noun Phrase (the torrential downpour). 'Although' dan 'Even though' wajib diikuti klausa lengkap (Subject + Verb).
hints: Diikuti langsung oleh frasa kata benda (noun phrase).
Gunakan 'Despite'.

simple.prompt: Contrast with a clause: '___ she was tired, she reviewed the audit report thoroughly.'
simple.explanation: 'Although' diikuti oleh klausa lengkap (she was tired).
hints: Diikuti klausa subjek + predikat.
Gunakan 'Although'.

simple.targetSentence: The prototype was innovative however it was too expensive.
simple.explanation: The prototype was innovative + however it was too expensive.
hints: Klausa pertama: 'The prototype was innovative'.
Klausa kontras: 'however it was too expensive'.

simple.prompt: Cause and effect: 'The flight was delayed ___ technical difficulties with the navigation system.'
simple.explanation: 'Due to' / 'Owing to' / 'Because of' diikuti oleh noun phrase ('technical difficulties').
hints: Diikuti frasa nomina (bukan klausa).
Gunakan 'due to'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan 'In spite of the rain'.
simple.targetSentence: In spite of the rain they enjoyed the city tour.
simple.explanation: In spite of the rain + they enjoyed the city tour.
hints: Mulai dengan frasa konsesi: 'In spite of the rain'.
Klausa utama: 'they enjoyed the city tour'.

simple.prompt: Addition linking word: 'The company expanded its sales territory; ___, it hired fifty engineers.'
simple.explanation: 'Furthermore' / 'Moreover' digunakan untuk menambahkan poin pendukung yang searah secara formal.
hints: Menambahkan informasi pendukung.
Gunakan 'furthermore'.

simple.targetSentence: Demand rose rapidly consequently prices surged across the market.
simple.explanation: Demand rose rapidly + consequently prices surged across the market.
hints: Sebab: 'Demand rose rapidly'.
Akibat: 'consequently prices surged across the market'.

simple.prompt: ___ the coastal highway was foggy, the morning shuttle arrived ten minutes ahead of schedule.
simple.explanation: Setelah rumpang ada klausa penuh S+V ('the coastal highway was foggy'), sehingga wajib memakai subordinating conjunction konsesif 'Although' (bukan preposition 'Despite').
hints: Periksa apakah di belakang rumpang ada Subject + Verb.
Klausa pertentangan diawali 'Although'.

simple.prompt: ___ severe coastal fog, the morning shuttle arrived safely at Terminal 1.
simple.explanation: Setelah rumpang hanya ada frasa benda ('severe coastal fog') tanpa verb, jadi wajib memakai preposisi 'Despite'.
hints: Tidak ada kata kerja setelah rumpang.
Frasa benda pertentangan memakai 'Despite'.

simple.prompt: Sales volume doubled in Q3; ___, net profit remained flat due to higher freight tariffs.
simple.explanation: Di antara dua klausa lengkap yang dipisah titik koma (;) dan diikuti koma (,), gunakan conjunctive adverb 'however'.
hints: Ada tanda titik koma (;) sebelum rumpang dan koma (,) sesudahnya.
Posisi ini khusus untuk conjunctive adverb seperti 'however'.

simple.prompt: Our solar output exceeded targets this quarter; ___, we postponed installing extra batteries.
simple.explanation: 'Therefore' menyatakan akibat/kesimpulan logis yang dihasilkan dari klausa pertama (listrik surya berlebih → menunda pasang baterai ekstra).
hints: Hubungan antara kedua kalimat adalah sebab → akibat logis.
Akibat memakai 'therefore'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penekanan tambahan informasi positif.
dialogue: Why should we adopt this cloud archive tool?
It encrypts files automatically. ___, it syncs offline edits seamlessly.
simple.explanation: 'Furthermore' (setara 'Moreover' / 'In addition') menambahkan poin pendukung searah yang memperkuat argumen pertama.
hints: Poin kedua mendukung argumen keunggulan yang sama.
Penambah argumen searah memakai 'Furthermore'.

simple.prompt: Carry an offline map on your phone ___ mobile reception drops inside the mountain tunnel.
simple.explanation: 'In case' berarti 'untuk berjaga-jaga kalau-kalau...', menyatakan langkah antisipasi.
hints: Mengunduh peta offline adalah persiapan berjaga-jaga.
Langkah antisipasi memakai 'in case'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda menyisipkan 'of' setelah 'Despite' berikut.
simple.draft: Despite of two postponed deliveries, our retail partners renewed their annual contract.
options: Despite two postponed deliveries, our retail partners renewed their annual contract.
Although two postponed deliveries, our retail partners renewed their annual contract.
Despite that two postponed deliveries, our retail partners renewed their annual contract.
simple.explanation: 'Despite' tidak pernah diikuti kata 'of'; gunakan 'Despite + noun phrase' secara langsung (atau 'In spite of').
hints: 'Despite of' tidak pernah benar dalam bahasa Inggris.
Hapus kata 'of' setelah 'Despite'.

simple.prompt: You need to confirm the wire transfer before four; ___, the shipment won't leave today.
simple.explanation: 'Otherwise' bermakna 'kalau tidak demikian, akibat negatifnya adalah...'.
hints: Menunjukkan konsekuensi jika transfer tidak segera dikonfirmasi.
Konsekuensi syarat negatif memakai 'otherwise'.

simple.targetSentence: Urban stations run trains every five minutes, whereas rural lines operate hourly.
simple.explanation: 'Whereas' mempertentangkan dua fakta yang berlawanan secara langsung.
hints: Awali dengan 'Urban stations run trains every five minutes,'.
Tambahkan kontras 'whereas rural lines operate hourly'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tujuan formal dengan 'in order to'.
simple.targetSentence: Engineers reinforced the levee walls in order to protect nearby farmland.
simple.explanation: 'In order to + V1' menjelaskan tujuan dari tindakan penguatan tanggul.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Engineers reinforced the levee walls'.
Tambahkan frasa tujuan 'in order to protect nearby farmland'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog analisis komparatif bisnis dengan 'whereas'.
dialogue: Domestic sales declined by 4% in Q3.
Indeed, ___ our overseas exports expanded by nearly 12%.
intermediate.explanation: 'Whereas' / 'While' digunakan untuk menyandingkan dua fakta kontras yang saling berhadapan secara seimbang.
hints: Menjajarkan dua perbandingan kontras langsung.
Gunakan 'whereas'.

intermediate.prompt: Condition with negative assumption: 'We must finalize the contract now, ___ the vendor will raise their prices.'
hints: Menyatakan konsekuensi negatif bila kondisi tidak dipenuhi.
Gunakan 'otherwise'.

intermediate.prompt: Concession with 'Notwithstanding': '___ the global economic headwinds, the conglomerate posted record profits.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Notwithstanding' adalah preposisi konsesi bernada sangat formal (mirip despite) yang diikuti noun phrase.
hints: Kata penghubung konsesi formal setara 'despite'.
Gunakan 'Notwithstanding'.

intermediate.targetSentence: The journey was arduous nevertheless they persevered until the summit.
intermediate.explanation: The journey was arduous + nevertheless they persevered until the summit.
hints: Kondisi sulit: 'The journey was arduous'.
Penegasan sikap: 'nevertheless they persevered until the summit'.

intermediate.prompt: Purpose linking: 'The safety valve was installed ___ steam pressure would not exceed critical thresholds.'
intermediate.explanation: 'So that' diikuti oleh klausa lengkap bermodal (would not exceed) untuk menyatakan tujuan.
hints: Diikuti klausa lengkap dengan modalitas.
Gunakan 'so that'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tujuan dengan 'in order that'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Measures were introduced in order that transparency could be maintained.
intermediate.explanation: Measures were introduced + in order that transparency could be maintained.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Measures were introduced'.
Klausa tujuan: 'in order that transparency could be maintained'.

dialogue: Should we purchase the surplus insurance package?
Yes, ___ unexpected natural disruptions occur during transit.
intermediate.explanation: 'In case' digunakan untuk aksi pencegahan terhadap kemungkinan terjadinya hal yang tidak diinginkan di masa depan.
hints: Tindakan pencegahan/berjaga-jaga.
Gunakan 'in case'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ the fact that our design sprint lost two days to server maintenance, we launched the beta on time.
intermediate.explanation: Walaupun mengandung 'that...', inti sesudah rumpang adalah frasa benda 'the fact', sehingga wajib diawali preposisi 'In spite of' / 'Despite'.
hints: Kata benda utama setelah rumpang adalah 'the fact'.
Preposisi 'In spite of' cocok sebelum 'the fact that...'.

intermediate.prompt: The experimental battery lasted twice as long in cold chambers; ___, manufacturing costs remain prohibitive for now.
intermediate.explanation: 'Nevertheless' (setara 'nonetheless' / 'however') mengakui kelebihan poin pertama namun menyajikan kendala kontras yang penting.
hints: Kalimat kedua menghadirkan kendala yang bertolak belakang dengan keunggulan pertama.
Pilih 'nevertheless'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi diskusi akademik dengan penanda ilustrasi yang presisi.
dialogue: Your paragraph makes a strong general claim about micro-credentials. Can you ground it?
Yes — I'll insert a concrete case right after it introduced by ___.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk memperkenalkan contoh spesifik pendukung klaim umum, gunakan 'for example' atau 'for instance'.
hints: Fungsinya memberi contoh konkret setelah klaim umum.
Penanda contoh adalah 'for example / for instance'.

intermediate.prompt: The regional coordinator stayed calm ___ the heated budget debate, offering practical compromises.
intermediate.explanation: Preposisi 'throughout' menyatakan sesuatu yang konsisten berlangsung di sepanjang periode/acara ('selama keseluruhan debat').
hints: Diikuti frasa benda 'the heated budget debate'.
'Throughout' bermakna sepanjang berlangsungnya acara.

intermediate.prompt: We labeled every reagent bottle in bold ink ___ technicians wouldn't confuse the solutions.
intermediate.explanation: 'So that' adalah konjungsi tujuan yang diikuti klausa lengkap (S + modal 'wouldn't' + V1).
hints: Ada klausa lengkap ('technicians wouldn't confuse...') setelah rumpang.
Konjungsi tujuan sebelum klausa lengkap adalah 'so that'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan 'Although' dan 'yet/but' secara ganda berikut.
intermediate.draft: Even though the quarterly survey attracted fewer responses than expected, yet its statistical margin stayed tight.
options: Even though the quarterly survey attracted fewer responses than expected, its statistical margin stayed tight.
Even though the quarterly survey attracted fewer responses than expected, but its statistical margin stayed tight.
Although the quarterly survey attracted fewer responses than expected, so its statistical margin stayed tight.
intermediate.explanation: Jangan menggabungkan konjungsi konsesif ('Even though' / 'Although') di awal klausa pertama dengan 'yet' atau 'but' di awal klausa kedua.
hints: Cukup gunakan satu penghubung pertentangan saja.
Hapus kata 'yet' setelah koma.

intermediate.prompt: ___, rapid urban expansion creates housing pressure; on the other hand, it stimulates transit investment.
intermediate.explanation: Pasangan retoris baku untuk 'on the other hand' saat menimbang dua sisi sebuah isu adalah 'On the one hand'.
hints: Lihat penanda di klausa kedua: 'on the other hand'.
Pasangan tetapnya adalah 'On the one hand'.

intermediate.prompt: Our prototype performs well under steady voltage; ___, sudden power surges still trigger false resets.
intermediate.explanation: 'Conversely' / 'By contrast' menandai perbandingan dua kondisi atau hasil yang berkebalikan.
hints: Membandingkan kondisi stabil vs lonjakan tegangan dengan hasil berlawanan.
Pilih 'conversely'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat menggunakan frasa 'in order not to' untuk tujuan negatif.
intermediate.targetSentence: The pilot lowered altitude gradually in order not to startle passengers.
intermediate.explanation: 'In order not to + V1' menyatakan tujuan menghindari sesuatu (letakkan 'not' tepat sebelum 'to').
hints: Awali dengan 'The pilot lowered altitude gradually'.
Tambahkan 'in order not to startle passengers'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan titik koma + 'nevertheless' untuk konsesi formal.
intermediate.targetSentence: Public transit subsidies strain city budgets; nevertheless, they reduce highway congestion substantially.
intermediate.explanation: Dua klausa independen yang bertolak belakang disambung dengan titik koma + 'nevertheless,' + koma.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Public transit subsidies strain city budgets;'.
Sambungkan dengan 'nevertheless, they reduce...'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi redundant connector pada klausa konsesi.
complex.draft: Although the fiscal policy was austere, but it successfully stabilized the national currency.
options: Although the fiscal policy was austere, it successfully stabilized the national currency.
Although the fiscal policy was austere, however it stabilized the currency.
In spite of the policy was austere, but it stabilized the currency.
complex.explanation: Kesalahan umum bilingual: Jangan pernah menggabungkan 'Although' dan 'But' dalam satu kesatuan kalimat majemuk. Hapus kata 'but'.
hints: Pantang memasangkan 'Although' dengan 'but'.
Hapus 'but'.

complex.prompt: Cohesive signaling in academic argumentation: Which linker introduces an inevitable logical consequence?
complex.explanation: 'It follows that...' adalah ungkapan kohesi deduktif formal yang menandai kesimpulan logis yang tak terbantahkan.
hints: Penanda deduksi logika formal.
Pilih 'It follows that'.

complex.prompt: Adcessive concessive concession: '___ that the initial expenditure is substantial, the long-term energy savings justify the investment.'
complex.explanation: 'Granted that...' / 'Admittedly...' digunakan untuk mengakui kebenaran suatu poin counter-argument sebelum kemudian membantahnya.
hints: Mengakui kebenaran argumen lawan sebelum membantah.
Gunakan 'Granted'.

complex.targetSentence: Insofar as the data is accurate the conclusions remain valid.
complex.explanation: Insofar as the data is accurate + the conclusions remain valid.
hints: Mulai dengan pembatas: 'Insofar as the data is accurate'.
Klausa utama: 'the conclusions remain valid'.

complex.draft: The hypothesis was refuted, on the contrary, new evidence supported the rival theory.
options: The hypothesis was refuted; on the contrary, new evidence supported the rival theory.
The hypothesis was refuted, however on the contrary new evidence supported the rival theory.
The hypothesis was refuted despite on the contrary new evidence supported it.
complex.explanation: Penghubung transisi antarklausa mandiri (conjunctive adverb seperti 'on the contrary') harus diawali titik koma (;) atau titik (.), bukan sekadar koma (comma splice).
hints: Hindari comma splice.
Gunakan titik koma sebelum 'on the contrary'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with accurate register for introducing exemplification without conversational cliches:
options: The pharmaceutical firm manufactures numerous biological agents, namely monoclonal antibodies and recombinant vaccines.
The pharmaceutical firm makes stuff, like for example antibodies.
The pharmaceutical firm makes drugs such like vaccines.
complex.explanation: 'Namely' adalah linking adverb berbobot tinggi yang digunakan untuk merinci dan memperjelas entitas yang baru saja disebutkan.
hints: Gaya bahasa formal dan presisi tinggi.
Pilih kalimat dengan 'namely'.

dialogue: The methodology is rigorous; ___ do the authors address potential sample bias?
complex.explanation: 'Yet nowhere do the authors address...' menggabungkan kontras konsesif ('yet') dengan inversi negatif ('nowhere do the authors...').
hints: Kontras elegan yang memicu inversi.
Gunakan 'yet nowhere'.

complex.prompt: Identify the sentence that punctuates a conjunctive adverb PROPERLY without creating a comma splice:
options: The clinical trial showed promising efficacy; nonetheless, larger multi-center replication is needed.
The clinical trial showed promising efficacy, nonetheless, larger multi-center replication is needed.
The clinical trial showed promising efficacy; nonetheless larger multi-center replication is needed.
complex.explanation: Saat menghubungkan dua klausa independen, conjunctive adverb ('nonetheless', 'however', 'therefore', 'moreover') WAJIB didahului titik koma (;) atau titik (.) DAN diikuti koma (,).
hints: Titik koma sebelum 'nonetheless' dan koma tepat sesudahnya.
Koma di kedua sisi menciptakan comma splice.

complex.prompt: ___ ambitious the municipal rail plan appeared in 2018, rising steel prices forced engineers to phase construction.
complex.explanation: Pola konsesif tingkat lanjut 'However + Adjective + Subject + Verb' berarti 'Betapapun [berambisi]-nya rencana itu...' (setara 'No matter how ambitious...').
hints: Perhatikan adjective 'ambitious' berada tepat setelah rumpang sebelum subjek.
Pola 'However + adj + S + V' bermakna konsesi tingkat lanjut.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan konjungsi tujuan 'for' vs 'so that' + redundansi penghubung berikut.
complex.draft: Because our regional hub lacked cold storage, therefore local growers couldn't export fresh berries.
options: Because our regional hub lacked cold storage, local growers couldn't export fresh berries.
Because of our regional hub lacked cold storage, therefore local growers couldn't export fresh berries.
Since our regional hub lacked cold storage, so local growers couldn't export fresh berries.
complex.explanation: Jangan pernah menggabungkan 'Because/Since' di awal klausa pertama dengan 'therefore/so' di awal klausa kedua; keduanya menyatakan sebab-akibat yang sama sehingga menjadi ganda.
hints: Satu hubungan sebab-akibat hanya memakai SATU penghubung ('Because' atau 'therefore', bukan keduanya).
Hapus 'therefore' setelah koma.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang pemakaian kata ganti penghubung khusus ('albeit') sebelum frasa tanpa verb.
dialogue: Can we compress 'The desalination filter succeeded, although it operated at high energy cost' cleanly?
Yes — insert the formal concessive particle ___ right before the prepositional phrase: '...succeeded, ___ at high energy cost.'
complex.explanation: 'Albeit' adalah konjungsi konsesif ringkas dan elegan dalam penulisan akademik untuk langsung memperkenalkan frasa sifat, keterangan, atau preposisi tanpa verb ('albeit slowly', 'albeit at high cost').
hints: Hanya ada frasa preposisi 'at high energy cost' tanpa kata kerja.
'Albeit' (= walaupun) sangat ringkas sebelum adjective/prepositional phrase.

complex.prompt: Smart as the automated billing algorithm was, ___ could it interpret handwritten customs notes.
complex.explanation: Pola 'Smart as the algorithm was, ___ could it interpret...' memakai inversi negatif setelah koma dengan 'in no way' diikuti modal 'could it'.
hints: Lihat inversi 'could it interpret' di klausa kedua.
Frasa negatif 'in no way' memicu inversi 'could it interpret'.

complex.prompt: In academic English, 'Such as' introduces examples WITHOUT a standalone verb; which sentence uses it accurately?
options: Renewable grids rely on storage technologies such as pumped hydro and lithium-iron batteries.
Renewable grids rely on storage technologies, such as, pumped hydro and batteries.
Such as pumped hydro, renewable grids rely on storage technologies.
complex.explanation: 'Such as' tidak memerlukan koma sebelum kata benda contoh yang mengikuti langsung ('technologies such as X and Y'), dan tidak digunakan seperti 'for example,' dengan koma mengapit.
hints: 'Such as' bukan adverb penghubung kalimat seperti 'for example,'.
Letakkan langsung antara kategori umum dan daftar contohnya.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menggabungkan 'While' (kontras) dengan 'on the contrary' yang maknanya keliru berikut.
complex.draft: The study hypothesized that remote workers sleep less; on the contrary, it also confirmed they exercise more.
options: The study hypothesized that remote workers sleep less; moreover, it found they exercise more.
The study hypothesized that remote workers sleep less; on the contrary, it also confirmed they exercise more.
The study hypothesized that remote workers sleep less; despite that, it also confirmed they exercise more.
complex.explanation: 'On the contrary' HANYA dipakai untuk MEMBANTAH pernyataan negatif/salah sebelumnya ('bahkan sebaliknya, klaim itu salah!'); untuk menambah temuan sejajar yang mengejutkan tanpa membantah hipotesis tidur, gunakan 'moreover' / 'furthermore'.
hints: 'On the contrary' khusus menyangkal pernyataan sebelumnya.
Karena kalimat kedua menambah temuan lain, pakai 'moreover'.

complex.prompt: ___ the initial grant covers laboratory equipment, ongoing technician salaries must come from institutional funds.
complex.explanation: Mengontraskan dua sumber pembiayaan yang berbeda ('equipment' vs 'salaries') menggunakan subordinating conjunction 'Whereas' di awal kalimat.
hints: Kedua klausa membandingkan dua porsi tanggung jawab yang berbeda.
Gunakan konjungsi kontras 'Whereas'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat konsesif inversi tingkat lanjut dengan '[Adjective] + as + Subject + Verb'.
complex.targetSentence: Expensive as the geothermal turbines proved initially, they cut island power costs within five years.
complex.explanation: Pola 'Adjective + as + S + V' bermakna konsesi kuat setara 'Although the geothermal turbines proved expensive initially...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Expensive as the geothermal turbines proved initially,'.
Tambahkan hasil kontrasnya.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ringkas memakai partikel konsesif 'albeit'.
complex.targetSentence: The coastal ferry resumed daily crossings, albeit with reduced passenger capacity.
complex.explanation: 'Albeit' langsung diikuti frasa preposisi 'with reduced passenger capacity' tanpa membutuhkan verb tambahan.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The coastal ferry resumed daily crossings,'.
Tambahkan ', albeit with reduced passenger capacity'.
